detail: IntegrationFull intersects Integration (additionalProperties:false, required unique_key/display_name/provider/created_at/updated_at) with another additionalProperties:false object permitting only webhook_url and credentials. The official Basic response shown on this page is rejected by the latter. The node accepts this documented response without requesting sensitive include fields.

AllAuthCredentials includes OAuth1CredentialsWithRaw/OAuth2CredentialsWithRaw. Each intersects a closed base credential object with a closed object permitting only raw, so the required OAuth type/token fields and raw cannot coexist. The harness selects the published OAuth1 branch and cannot generate a valid response. The docs say this endpoint returns OAuth1/OAuth2 credentials and describe fetching/refreshing access tokens. The node parses these connection objects and removes their credentials from output.
